thread:
Rae (Marketing): Heads-up: planning a soft launch blog + webinar. Target publish Mon 11/04 11:00 PT. Need final changelog anchor + docs page, a concise bench stat for hero, and confirmation on inbound flow. cc @Sam @Jordan :spiral_calendar:

Sam (ProdEng): Canary scheduled Sun 11/03 12:00 PT. Perf note: we're observing ~35% cost reduction for sub-128 token requests with our revised batching and KV cache heuristics. Happy to say 'up to 35%'.

Jordan (Docs): Docs PR is live: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/525 includes upgrade notes and examples. I'll publish /release/1.8 page once we have the final blurb.

Rae (Marketing): Draft hero: "Up to 35% lower inference costs for short prompts" + CTA "Join our webinar". Is that precise enough, @Sam?

Sam (ProdEng): Add 'per-request' to be clear: "Up to 35% lower per-request inference cost for short prompts." No latency claims.

Iris (DevRel): Webinar live demo Thu 11/07 09:00 PT. We'll embed a signup form and route attendees to DevRel for follow-ups. Also recommend adding a quick 'how-to' gist in the post.

Noah (Growth): Inbound routing plan: HubSpot form w/ hidden field campaign=release_nov24, tag "release_nov24", Zap to #sales-inbound. UTMs: utm_campaign=release_nov24&utm_source=blog. We'll auto-send recording + bench summary to registrants.

Jordan (Docs): Suggested changelog snippet: ```
Performance: Batching + KV-cache updates reduce per-request cost by up to 35% on shorter prompts. See docs & public benchmark.
``` OK?

Rae (Marketing): Great. Sam, can you drop the public bench link and changelog permalink here so I can finalize the post?

Sam (ProdEng): Public bench: https://bench.redwood.ai/2024-11-03-summary
Changelog permalink: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/compare/v1.7.5...v1.8.0#perf
Docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.8

release-bot: Canary starts 1739006400 (2024-11-03T12:00:00Z)

Noah (Growth): We'll also run a tiny hero A/B: "Up to 35% lower per-request cost" vs "Make short requests up to 35% cheaper". I'll set it for 12h and report.

Iris (DevRel): I'll prepare slides + demo code, and host office hours Fri 11/08 8am PT.

Jordan (Docs): Once Rae confirms, I'll publish the release page and link the changelog anchor.

Rae (Marketing): Final: scheduling the post for Mon 11/04 11:00 PT with hero variant A. If no objections by EOD, go live. :rocket:

Sam (ProdEng): LGTM.

Noah (Growth): LGTM.

Iris (DevRel): LGTM.
